review.instruction: Compare every implemented operation, writer, store, transaction, idempotency rule, event and migration reference with the supplied frozen authority. Reject invented business behavior or a weakened proof.
Inspect the actual diff. Every changed path must be inside the declared mutable ceiling and outside protected paths; the mutation report must carry accurate before and after digests.

Read the raw proof commands, exit codes and outputs. Require coverage of declared success, validation, authorization, persistence and failure behavior; a command that did not run is not passing evidence.

failurePolicy: Produce, validate, inspect, give concrete failing-check feedback, repair only the affected source or record, and reassess. A done response requires every criteria result to pass within the finite feedback budget.
